architecture_authority.decision: A1 freezes pure canonical schemas and adapters only; assembly, retrieval, projections, prompts, and media behavior remain owned by their later tasks.

checks.name: canonical_artifact_envelope
checks.evidence: ArtifactEnvelope canonicalizes its content, validates local SHA-256 binding, freezes dependencies, and rejects a forged content hash.

checks.name: canonical_24000_tick_timebase
checks.evidence: CanonicalTimeline accepts only 24000 ticks/second; TickRange is half-open and GenerationSegmentTimeline begins locally at zero.

checks.name: draft_artifact_separation
checks.evidence: The four creative Draft families do not expose IDs, hashes, dependency digests, ticks, timelines, or VEC contract identifiers; IdFactory and ArtifactEnvelope are local-domain assembly types.

checks.name: no_duplicate_domain_authority
checks.evidence: Every domain module declares a unique canonical type authority list; the A1 test checks both module-local and package-wide uniqueness.

checks.name: domain_schemas_frozen_for_downstream
checks.evidence: All canonical dataclass schemas are frozen and every A1 module declares schema version 2.1 for downstream consumers.

checks.name: legacy_read_adapter_only
checks.evidence: The one-way B0/K2 adapter reads the retained JSON checkpoint into a canonical BlockingDraft ArtifactEnvelope and the mechanical import check forbids imports from legacy runtime code.

review.finding: Legacy vNext contracts and schema modules duplicate authority for artifacts, facts, timelines, and blocking; their time semantics cannot be imported into v2.1.
review.root_cause: The prior implementation grew as historical pipeline contracts rather than a single pure domain boundary.

considered_options.reason: Would retain duplicate authority and allow old pipeline/runtime dependencies to shape canonical v2.1 data.

considered_options.option: Create a parallel v2.1 domain with bidirectional adapters
considered_options.reason: Bidirectional conversion would let historical representations become a new normative write path.

considered_options.option: Create pure frozen canonical schemas with a one-way legacy reader
considered_options.reason: It preserves historical evidence while making v2.1 the only authority for all new downstream work.

review.residual_risk: A1 defines schemas only. Local VEC assembly, retrieval, renderer equivalence, bounded prompt compilation, media evidence, and production gates remain deliberately deferred to A2-A10.
